about: Lùi thì và đổi từ trong câu tường thuật (khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ: said, told, asked…). point = id điểm ngữ pháp chi tiết.
tenses: He said he had seen him.
She said she had been sleeping.
He said he would help me.
He said he might be late.
She said she had to go.
Past perfect · would · could · should · might
words: the day before / the previous day
the next day / the following day
the week before / the previous week
the following week / the week after
